ticket.summary: 15-year-old garbage disposal seized solid; customer wants straight replacement with a basic unit.

quote_lines.description: Garbage disposal replacement (standard unit included, old unit removed)

ticket.customer_message: Sorry we missed your call! A straight swap-out is $329 flat (GARB-DISPOSAL-REPLACE) — includes a standard new 1/2 HP unit, labor, and haul-away of the old one. No after-hours fee since this isn't an emergency. Earliest fit is tomorrow, Tue Sept 1 at 3:00 PM (about 1h45 booked, since 15-year-old mountings often need extra persuasion). I've reserved it for you — just reply if you'd like a different day instead.
